Plan: the pros' macro line on Comet Catcher from our B8 start. One vehicle plant with the commander on it, constructors expanding north and east from home, Blitz pickets at the outer spots, a Rover scout to find his base (likely the north-east, G1-H2, or along his strip).

commander: follows its build list (extractors, solars, the plant, then helping the plant). After the list its standing state is helping the plant. It attacks a raider party at a building of ours within its short walk when it outweighs it; it never chases a scout car or armflea it cannot catch, and never walks toward the middle alone.

plant: builds what its list allows, in order. Never idle.

constructors: extractors in this order, the first free one: spot_68, spot_62, spot_69, spot_61, spot_63, spot_54, spot_64, spot_76, spot_50, spot_52, spot_45, spot_59, spot_71, spot_43, spot_36, spot_56. A light turret (armllt) beside spot_62, spot_63, spot_64, spot_52 and spot_59 once their extractors stand. A radar (armrad) at spot_63 once it holds an extractor. A solar only when the energy line reads STALLING and metal holds 150 or more; banking or in balance: no solar. Never go past spot_56 or spot_43 toward the east or north.

armfav soldiers: two stay near spot_69 and spot_62 and attack any armflea, armpw or armfav at our extractors on sight; the rest scout.

armflash groups: pickets at spot_63 and spot_61; a lone raider at an extractor is met by one or two soldiers from the nearest group, never the whole group. When they are a handful they hold at spot_64 between our extractors and the east.

packet:
Plan: the pros' macro line on Comet Catcher from our B8 start. One vehicle plant with the commander on it, constructors expanding north and east from home, a Blitz raid on his middle extractors while turrets and new soldiers guard home. His base is at his_base (G1-H1); outposts at spot_17 (H3, two light turrets) and spot_16/spot_18 (F3, a light turret and a radar); his commander was seen at F1. Energy is full: no more solars.

commander: builds its list, then helps the plant, standing beside it, never in its exit lane. An armpw or armflea at spot_68, spot_74, spot_73, spot_67 or the plant is its job: it attacks that party while it stands within its short walk, then goes back. It never chases far, and never walks toward the middle alone.

plant: builds what its list allows. Never idle.

constructors: follow their lists; without a list, extractors in this order, the first free one: spot_62, spot_54, spot_50, spot_43, spot_56, spot_36, spot_38, spot_39, spot_30, spot_28, spot_58, spot_44. A light turret (armllt) beside each outer extractor. No solar while energy reads full or banking. Never go past spot_44 or spot_39 toward the east or north. A constructor with an armpw or armflea within its reach steps away from it toward the commander or our soldiers.

group_R (the Blitz body; whatever name it carries, the group of nine or more Blitzes): the raid, and it is already past its first stop. Its route, in order: spot_59 (reached), then spot_44, spot_37, spot_32, spot_20, spot_15, spot_16, spot_11, spot_8. At each stop it moves on at once to the next unless it is fighting something it outweighs there. It kills his extractors, solars, radars and constructors that no turret covers. It never walks into a light turret's reach (armllt) and never fights his commander (armcom). On a party it does not outweigh it holds out of reach and goes on to the next spot. After spot_8 it comes back to spot_59 by spot_21, spot_31, spot_33. It never turns back for a raider at home: against one armflea it sends one Rover at most, and otherwise leaves raiders to the home guard.

group_W and any other small group of ours: the home guard. Its post is spot_69. A raider party at any of our extractors or at home is met by the whole guard group together; the Rovers (armfav) in it catch armflea.

Plan: the army fights his parties on our ground at the base, beside the Pit Bull turrets (armpb). A second body kills the Fatboy (armfboy) and its two Hounds at spot_52/C5 now, all at once.

The home army is group_W10, group_H11, group_J11 and every new group from the plants. It gathers at front_gate and never stands at home, yard2 or spot_73 (the plants' lanes). It fights any enemy party at front_gate, spot_69, spot_76, spot_63, spot_64, spot_73 or home with the whole group, attack_unit on an armraz first when one is there; then it goes back to front_gate. It never goes east of spot_64 or north of spot_61.

The west body is group_V10, group_N11 and group_I11 together (about 8,000 metal). They join at spot_61, then go at the armfboy at spot_52 and C5 together, attack_unit on the armfboy with every soldier at once until it is dead, then the armfido with it. They never walk toward it one or two at a time. Then they hold spot_50 and attack the armmar or any small party at spot_45, spot_50, spot_43, spot_52, spot_54 or spot_62. They never go east of spot_59 or north of spot_38.

commander: stays at home (B8) beside plant_18227 and the fusion_yard, helping the plants and the Pit Bull builds, never in an exit lane. It never goes toward the armraz or a party that outreaches it. An armpw, armflea or armflash at home is its job within its short walk.

plants: build what their lists allow.

constructors: follow their lists. A constructor without a list helps build the nearest Pit Bull (armpb) frame; with none standing, it helps the plants. No extractors east of spot_63 or north of spot_50 while an armraz, armfboy or armmar is near. A constructor steps away from any enemy party near it. Never stand in a plant's exit lane.

group_T10 (Blitzes): stays at the fusion_yard and attacks an armflash, armpw or armflea at the fusion_yard, spot_68 or spot_74.

group_K10 (Blitzes): holds spot_62; attacks any armpw, armflea or armflash at spot_62, spot_54 or spot_45. Never fights armmar, armraz, armzeus or armspid.
